svg.title: S-Rank Missions — Flagship Production Platforms
svg.desc: Liquid Glass interactive showcase of Ajit Chowdary's flagship production platforms and enterprise solutions.

g.text: Production-deployed systems engineered with Angular 19, Flutter 3.x, & Java Spring Boot. High-volume bullion, fractional investment & civic utility platforms.
Digital gold & silver savings platform featuring DSP (Daily Savings Plan),
EMI installments, DigiLocker KYC, interactive payment calendars, store checkout,
agent referral trees, transaction ledgers, and dynamic PDF purchase agreements.
Cross-platform digital bullion investment app with live metal spot rates,
PhonePe payment gateway, in-app agreement rendering, Biometric auth
(Face ID / Fingerprint), SMS autofill OTP (Pinput), and DigiLocker web KYC.
Fractional real estate & proptech investment portal allowing investors to
browse fixed-income assets, simulate returns with financial calculators,
track recurring payout schedules, and run Playwright E2E regression tests.
Fractional asset investment mobile app engineered with Flutter Clean
Architecture and BLoC for deterministic state management across
product discovery, investor wallets, GoRouter navigation, & Dio auth.
High-frequency streaming app delivering live rates for 24K (999) gold,
22K (916) gold, 999 silver, and MCX commodities with dynamic TDS, GST,
premium spreads, marquee rate ticker display, and B2B booking forms.
Physical bullion trading desk app displaying live institutional bid/ask rates,
operational status, minted coin/bar product catalogs, and direct one-touch
trading desk connectivity via WhatsApp and direct telephone dialing.
ANDHRA PRADESH STATE DEPARTMENTS · AUTOMATION · OPEN SOURCE
STATUS: 6+ PRODUCTION PLATFORMS DEPLOYED · SPECIALIZATION: FINTECH & DIGITAL BULLION · CLIENTS: VIINDHYA GROUP & STATE OF ANDHRA PRADESH
